name: Lions Club
body:
Aura moderate summoning; CL 7; Weight 3 lbs.; Price 18,300 gp

DESCRIPTION

This +1 club is detailed with etchings of lions and symbols of boldness, royalty, and battle. One time per day, the wielder of this club may summon three lions who remain for 7 rounds. When attacking with the lions club, the wielder also gains the pounce special attack and is able to make a full attack at the end of a charge. Finally, the wielder also gains a +4 morale bonus to saving throws made against fear effects.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells remove fear, summon nature’s ally IV; Cost 9,150 gp
